objective: Speak with Thrall if you are prepared to take on the mission he has planned.

description: As Warchief, it is my duty to do what is best for the Horde. To ensure that the generations that come after us are not forced into a hopeless existence.

The opportunity to shape our future alliances has fallen into our collective laps. A move to help the dwarves could greatly strengthen our relationships in the Eastern Kingdoms. This, then, is why you must not fail!
completion: There is no going back beyond this point, <name>.
